fleet.runs.noVehicles: No vehicles on the road. Register one on the Vehicles tab — the run is sold on its space, so there has to be one.
fleet.runs.needVehicle: Say which vehicle is going. What you are selling is the space in it.
fleet.runs.tooMuch: That is more than the vehicle holds.
fleet.runs.capacityFrom: Leave it blank to sell all {kg} kg of {plate}.
fleet.runs.capacityM3Hint: Optional, and worth measuring once. A pallet of foam weighs nothing and fills half a truck — without this you will sell room you do not have.
fleet.runs.basisHint: Per trip is the honest default for a scheduled line. Per kilogram is the one that loses money on exactly the loads that fill a truck.
fleet.runs.notOfferedTitle: Your runs are not being offered to shippers
fleet.runs.notOffered: {why}. Nobody can book new space with you until this is put right. Runs already under way carry on as normal — deliver them as usual. Send the renewed document from “Your company’s papers” on the dashboard.
fleet.runs.currencyGuess: Your company record does not say which country you operate in, so prices are published in {currency}. Ask SeeBuyGet staff to set it before you sell space, or a shipper will book at a price you did not mean.
fleet.runs.minChargeHint: Optional. Stopping, opening the back and strapping something down is the expensive part of a small job.
fleet.runs.settleLede: Straight to you — SeeBuyGet takes no part in this payment and holds none of it. Saying it here is what stops a shipper assuming otherwise.
fleet.runs.coverLede: SeeBuyGet carries no cover on goods you move. Saying what you carry is what lets a shipper — or their broker — arrange the rest instead of finding out afterwards.
fleet.runs.coverLimit: You cover up to ({currency}, per load)
fleet.runs.coverHint: Type 0 if you carry none — that is an honest answer and a useful one. Leave it blank and shippers are told you have not said.
fleet.runs.claimAnswerLede: This goes to the shipper with the consignment note and both photographs. SeeBuyGet records it and does not decide it — settle the money between you.
fleet.runs.claimWhyPh: Loaded and signed for in that state — see the photograph at pickup.
fleet.runs.claimWhyHint: Required on a refusal. A refusal with no reason is not something the other side can do anything with.
fleet.callOff.title: Call off this run
fleet.callOff.lede: Everybody with goods on this run is told the moment you send this — with your reason, and what to do next.
fleet.callOff.ledeEmpty: Nobody has booked space on this run, so calling it off tells nobody.
fleet.callOff.swapTitle: Put another truck on it instead — every booking stays
fleet.callOff.noTruck: None of your other trucks is on the road and holds the {kg} kg already booked.
fleet.callOff.sameTruckTitle: {plate} is on your other runs too
fleet.callOff.rosterTitle: Put another driver on it instead — every booking stays
fleet.callOff.noDriver: You have no other active driver to put on it.
fleet.callOff.whereMap: Tap the map where it is closed
fleet.callOff.whereRoadHint: Drop a pin and it goes onto the road-hazard map for every driver, as your report: others can confirm or dispute it, and our staff clear it when it opens.
fleet.callOff.whereBorderHint: Drop a pin at the crossing and it goes onto the road-hazard map as your report — and in front of our staff, who decide what the network does about a closed border.
fleet.callOff.routeTold: The shippers are told that other trucks on this route meet the same closure.
fleet.callOff.otherRunsTold: The shippers are told to find another truck, and how many other runs on this route are open.
fleet.callOff.cta: Call it off and tell the shippers
fleet.callOff.doneToastDetail: Everybody with goods on it has been told, with your reason.
fleet.callOff.doneToastMapped: Everybody on it has been told, and the closure is on the hazard map.
fleet.callOff.swappedToast: {plate} is on the run — every booking stands
fleet.callOff.rosteredToast: {name} is on the run — every booking stands
fleet.giveBack.title: Give the space back
fleet.giveBack.lede: {load} comes off this run, and the shipper is told why the moment you send it.
fleet.giveBack.goodsHint: The shipper is told to book again with what they are actually sending.
fleet.giveBack.told: The shipper reads this as you write it, and it stays on their booking.
fleet.giveBack.send: Give it back and tell the shipper
fleet.giveBack.doneToastDetail: The shipper has been told, with your reason.
fleet.runs.waitingLede: Leave these empty and you do not charge for waiting. Fill them both and a shipper sees the terms before they book.
fleet.runs.waitingHint: Charged by the minute after the free window, never rounded up to a whole hour.
fleet.runs.needLine: Choose which of your lines this run is on.
fleet.runs.past: That time has passed — a departure has to be ahead of now.
fleet.runs.needCapacity: Say how much weight is for sale.
fleet.runs.needKm: Charging by the kilometre needs the distance this line runs, or every booking prices at nothing.
fleet.runs.needFreeTime: Charging for waiting needs the free time first — how long is loading simply expected to take?
fleet.trips.title: Trips every week
fleet.trips.lede: Set your drivers’ trips like an alarm: before each one they are told the loads on their way. Selling space, each run is put on sale a week ahead on your line.
fleet.trips.selling: {n, plural, =0 {Space for sale: no run posted yet} one {Space for sale: # run posted} other {Space for sale: # runs posted}}
fleet.trips.postError: The next run could not be put on sale: {why}
fleet.trips.placePh: A depot, a town, a market
fleet.trips.mapLabel: Tap the map to place it
fleet.trips.notFound: Could not find that place — tap the map to place it yourself.
fleet.trips.placeHow: Type the name and tap “Find it on the map”, or place it on the map yourself.
fleet.trips.back: And back at (leave empty if not)
fleet.trips.sell: Sell the free space on each run
fleet.trips.noLine: Space is sold on one of your published lines: propose one under Lines first.
fleet.trips.capacity: Kg for sale (empty: all the vehicle carries)
fleet.toast.tripSavedDetail: Your driver sees it, and is told the loads on the way before each run.
fleet.runs.noDriverWhy: Nobody can record waiting time at a gate until you say who is driving.
fleet.runs.waitLine: {minutes} min over the free time — {amount} {currency} from the {bearer}
fleet.runs.waitLineOwn: {minutes} min over the free time — {customer} is yours to bill, on your terms
fleet.runs.waiveBody: The wait stays on the record — it happened — and only the amount goes to zero. Say why, so the decision can be read back later.
fleet.runs.aloud: {count} runs on the board, {open} still taking bookings.
fleet.runs.ownRow: For {customer} — your own customer, at your price
fleet.own.add: Add a load of your own
fleet.own.title: A load you already had
fleet.own.lede: For a customer of yours, not one who found you here. Nothing is charged and they need no account — you are telling us the load exists so we stop offering the space it takes.
fleet.own.leftBoth: {kg} kg and {m3} m³ left on this run.
fleet.own.chargeHint: Optional, and only for your own run sheet — we do not quote it, bill it or take any part of it. Leave it blank and the load still takes up the space.
fleet.own.needCustomer: Say whose load it is — in whatever name you file them under.
fleet.own.needWhat: Say what it is. The driver is loading it.
fleet.own.noRoomKg: That is more than the {kg} kg still free on this run.
fleet.own.noRoomM3: It weighs little enough, but only {m3} m³ of space is left.
fleet.toast.ownAddedDetail: {customer}’s load is aboard, and that space is no longer being offered.
fleet.toast.runDeclaredDetail: Shippers can book the space now.
fleet.chat.title: Conversations your drivers shared
fleet.chat.empty: No driver has shared a conversation with you. A driver can share one from inside it, and you can read it here.
fleet.lines.title: Your lines
fleet.lines.lede: A line is a route your own vehicles run between two zones. Propose it here. Once the network publishes it, shops in the first zone can hand your drivers parcels for it, and only your drivers run it.
fleet.lines.none: You have not proposed a line yet.
fleet.lines.name: Name (optional)
fleet.lines.noteHint: The network reads this when deciding whether to publish it.
fleet.lines.needZones: A line runs from one zone to another. Name both ends.
fleet.lines.sameZone: Both ends are the same zone. A line is only used for a parcel crossing zones.
fleet.lines.duplicate: A line already runs, or waits to run, on that pair, and only the first is ever found.
fleet.lines.aloud: You have {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}. {waiting} are waiting for the network.
fleet.gate.title: This app needs updating
fleet.gate.body: A newer version is required before you can carry on working.
fleet.signin.aloud: Sign in with your phone number and PIN, or with your fleet’s sign-in code. New fleet? Sign it up on the SeeBuyGet front page.
fleet.signin.title: Open your fleet
fleet.signin.lede: Type your fleet’s sign-in code, then your own phone number and PIN.
fleet.signin.phoneLede: Your own phone number and PIN. If you manage more than one fleet, you choose which to open.
fleet.signin.pinNote: No PIN yet? Choose “Forgot your PIN?” to set one. Your own PIN, not the company code — so the fleet can see who did what, and one person leaving does not change everybody else’s sign-in.
fleet.signin.forgot: Sign in with your phone number instead
fleet.signin.noFleets: This phone does not manage a fleet yet. Signing up a new fleet? Use “New here? Sign up” below. Joining one that is here already? Ask its office to add your number.
fleet.signin.stands.draft: Signed up — its papers came back: send them again from the sign-up
fleet.signin.stands.pending: Signed up — its papers are with SeeBuyGet
fleet.signin.stands.approved: Papers approved — the bond is recorded next
fleet.signin.backToCode: Have a fleet code? Use it
fleet.code.title: Fleet sign-in code
fleet.code.note: It names your company at sign-in; each manager still signs in with their own phone and PIN. It never adds anyone to your fleet — you do that yourself, under Drivers.
fleet.code.rotateWarn: The old code stops working at once. Nobody is signed out — tell your managers the new code for their next sign-in.
fleet.code.rotated: New code issued. The old one no longer works.
fleet.signin.codeNote: SeeBuyGet issued this code when your company was activated.
fleet.signin.can1: Register vehicles and print their dashboard QRs
fleet.signin.can2: Onboard drivers and send their papers to SeeBuyGet
fleet.signin.can3: See who is on shift, where, with what cargo
fleet.ownPapers.enforced: Your company enforces: {papers}. If one of these lapses, your runs come off the board until it is renewed.
fleet.ownPapers.coverOn: Insurance cover checked by SeeBuyGet, up to {limit} a load, until {until}: loads whose sender asks for cover are open to your drivers.
fleet.ownPapers.coverOff: No insurance cover checked by SeeBuyGet: loads whose sender asks for cover are closed to your drivers. Send your carrier insurance policy to open them.
fleet.ownPapers.notEnforced: Nothing here is enforced right now — a lapse is shown, and costs you no work.
fleet.ownPapers.waiting: Sent {date}, reading {expires} — waiting for SeeBuyGet to check it. Nothing changes until they do.
fleet.ownPapers.sheetBodyLicence: Photograph the renewed transport licence so the expiry date and the number can be read. SeeBuyGet staff check it and record the date — until they do, the date you type here changes nothing.
fleet.ownPapers.sheetBodyInsurance: Photograph the renewed insurance certificate — the certificate, not the quote — so the expiry date and the policy number can be read. SeeBuyGet staff check it and record the date; until they do, the date you type here changes nothing.
fleet.ownPapers.expires: Expiry date, as it reads on the document
fleet.ownPapers.sentToastDetail: SeeBuyGet staff will check it and record the date. The answer shows on this card.
fleet.papers.due: {kind} runs out {day} ({days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}})
fleet.papers.onShiftEnds: On a shift right now — the next check ends it
fleet.papers.cardNote: Insurance, inspection certificates and driving licences, by their dates. The day after a date passes, that vehicle or driver is off the road until you record the renewal. Anything running out within 30 days is listed here first.
fleet.papers.clear: Nothing has lapsed, and nothing runs out within 30 days.
fleet.papers.counts: {inDate, plural, one {# paper} other {# papers}} in date · {unrecorded} with no date recorded
fleet.papers.aloudLapsed: {count} off the road for lapsed papers.
fleet.papers.aloudDue: {count, plural, one {# paper} other {# papers}} running out within thirty days.
fleet.vehicles.papersBody: The reference and the expiry date on each paper. The day after a date passes, this vehicle is off the road until you record the renewal here — the new date is the whole of the renewal.
fleet.vehicles.papersHint: Optional, and switched on by the date: a paper with no date switches nothing off — and nothing watches it for you either.
fleet.drivers.licenceBody: Record the renewed licence as you have seen it. The new date is what puts the driver back on the road; there is nothing else to clear.
fleet.toast.papersSavedDetail: The dates are watched from now on.
fleet.toast.licenceSavedDetail: The new date counts from now.
fleet.card.sentRow: Sent their renewed licence {date}. Read it.
fleet.card.waitingDetail: Each was sent from the driver app. Until you read the card and record its date, nothing changes for that driver.
fleet.card.title: The card they sent
fleet.card.body: Read the expiry date off the photograph and type it yourself. Their reading is shown so you can compare; it is never copied into the record for you.
fleet.card.read: Sent {date}. They read the expiry as {expires}.
fleet.card.open: Open the photo at full size
fleet.card.goneDetail: Say so under “Not accepted”, and they can send it again. Or record the date from the card itself if they are with you.
fleet.card.readDate: Expiry date, as you read it on the card
fleet.card.differs: That is not the date they read ({expires})
fleet.card.differsDetail: Look at the card again before recording it.
fleet.card.datePast: That date has already passed. A renewed licence runs into the future.
fleet.card.refuseWhy: Why not — they are shown exactly this
fleet.card.refusedToastDetail: {name} is told why, and can send another.
fleet.card.fromCard: This date was read from the card they sent, recorded {date}.
fleet.card.fromWord: This date was recorded {date} with no photograph: from the card as somebody saw it.
fleet.card.recordedCard: The card this date was read from
fleet.card.lastRefused: Their last card was not accepted on {date}: “{reason}” They have been told, and can send another.
fleet.card.howItArrives: A driver whose licence is running out is asked for a photo of the new card in the driver app. It arrives here to be read. You can also record the date from the card itself, as before.
fleet.papers.cardSentRow: Sent their new card. Read it under Drivers.
fleet.earn.cardBody: Every haul your drivers carried, who earned what, and where the money is: booked, on its way, or paid.
fleet.dispatch.cardBody: Put a load on one of your drivers on shift ({n} right now). You see the market exactly as they would — priced against their vehicle, with every reason it cannot be taken marked.
fleet.dispatch.title: Dispatch
fleet.dispatch.lede: The market as your driver sees it. Putting a load on them locks the price at their vehicle’s rate, puts it on their list, tells them, and records that it was the office’s call.
fleet.dispatch.nobody: Nobody is on a shift. Start one on the Shifts tab, then come back.
fleet.dispatch.howFar: How far from where they are
fleet.dispatch.fromDriver: Distances and prices are measured from where {name} last reported.
fleet.dispatch.fromDepot: {name}’s shift has not reported a position yet — measured from the depot until it does.
fleet.dispatch.count: {n, plural, one {# load} other {# loads}} · {can} they could take
fleet.dispatch.empty: No loads on the market within this reach.
fleet.dispatch.market.thin: Few loads are being posted anywhere this week, not just within this reach — the market itself is quiet.
fleet.dispatch.market.board: Loads are being posted elsewhere this week. Nothing is within this driver’s reach — try a wider radius, or a driver standing somewhere else.
fleet.dispatch.negotiate: Posted for negotiation — the driver can send the shipper a price from their board; it cannot be assigned at the counter rate.
fleet.dispatch.assignedDetail: They have been told. It is on their list, to collect at the pickup.
fleet.dispatch.aloud: {n, plural, one {# load} other {# loads}} on the market for {name}, {can} they could take.
fleet.dispatch.aloudNobody: Nobody is on a shift, so there is nobody to put a load on.
fleet.earn.title: Earnings
fleet.earn.lede: Your fleet is paid as one supplier for every haul its drivers carry. This is the list payday is checked against.
fleet.earn.sub: {booked} booked · {pending} not yet delivered · {delivered} of {count, plural, one {# haul} other {# hauls}} delivered
fleet.earn.subEmpty: What your drivers’ hauls have earned — for whatever you filter to below.
fleet.earn.moneyNote: Booked means the network has written down what it owes you. Paid out means a payment rail confirmed the money left. They are not the same thing, and this screen never says one when it means the other.
fleet.earn.moneyNoteNoSister: Your fleet stands where the network only matches loads, so no network company pays you: each haul is settled between you and the shipper.
fleet.earn.listEmpty: No hauls yet. When a driver of yours claims a load, it lands here.
fleet.dispatch.paidByShipper: The shipper pays your fleet directly, at the price agreed here. SeeBuyGet pays nothing for this load.
fleet.earn.aloud: Earned {earned}. {owed} booked as owed to you, {settled} paid out.
fleet.earn.aloudEmpty: Your fleet’s earnings will show here.
fleet.dash.mapNoneNote: Nobody is reporting a position right now. This is the area you work in.
fleet.dash.mapNote: Vehicles on shift, where their phones last reported — a driver’s phone reports only while their shift runs. Tap one for its load and where it goes next.
fleet.map.lineToPickup: {plate} to collect at {place} — a straight line, not the road
fleet.map.lineToDrop: {plate} to deliver at {place} — a straight line, not the road
fleet.map.keyLines: A line runs from a vehicle to its next stop, marked with a ring: straight, because the road it takes is the driver’s.
fleet.map.stopNote: {count, plural, one {# vehicle on the map has} other {# vehicles on the map have}} this as the next stop. Tap one for its load and hours.
fleet.map.keyHazards: Red diamonds: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} drivers reported on the roads around your vehicles.
